{{Top|leg}}
A '''naming day''', or '''name-day''', was a special day in some cultures, similar to a [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]], for which gifts are given. [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gave [[Nirama]] a [[Bender (rancor)|juvenile rancor]] once as a naming day gift.

In the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] culture, the name-day was a significant date when it was also celebrated with gift-giving.
